task.description: Add Perc stat for computing percentiles ```python ( so.Plot(tips, "day", "total_bill") .add(so.Dot(), so.Perc(11)) .add(so.Range(linewidth=3), so.Perc([10, 90]), so.Shift(x=.1)) ) ```

requirements.patch_and_checks: Patch applies and the recorded executable checks pass.
requirements.file_location: Percentile computation belongs in the statistics layer and is exported through seaborn.objects.
requirements.api_contract: Perc accepts an integer number of evenly spaced percentiles or an explicit percentile list, plus an interpolation method, and implements the existing Stat call contract.
requirements.dependency_direction: Imports and dependency directions respect existing boundaries.
requirements.extension_registration: Expose Perc through seaborn.objects so it composes with Plot.add.
requirements.architectural_fit: Responsibilities belong in the intended layer or component.
requirements.extension_point_adherence: Use the Stat abstraction and existing GroupBy, orientation, and scale conventions rather than a standalone plotting implementation.
requirements.abstraction_integrity: Domain, transport, persistence, and framework boundaries are preserved.
requirements.convention_fit: Follow existing Stat naming, validation, error handling, documentation and test style. Added or modified tests must match local patterns. This pilot does not require a new test addition for this task; unchanged tests retain their existing style. Do not infer a mandatory addition solely from reference-only test files. Candidate-owned changed tests and the fixed reference regression checks must execute successfully.
requirements.requirement_intent: Percentiles work for both orientations, grouped data, missing values, and interpolation choices, preserving the objects plotting API.
